artifacts.name: CSR terminal wealth
artifacts.note: Ours beats the paper's CSR by 22% at k=3. But sweeping k shows why: the decomposition's advantage over CSR grows monotonically from $0 at k=1 to $113 at k=8. At the k=3 the paper reports, we see almost no gap; at k=6 we see $88. The mechanism reproduces, the location does not.

artifacts.name: CSM terminal wealth at k=3
artifacts.note: $122.33 at the paper's k=3. Sweeping k gives $104.62 at k=1 rising to $158.37 at k=6, so this single number is a 51% range depending on one specification choice. Our best k lands within 13% of the paper's headline, but not at the k they report.
